strengths: The medical case reads clearly in MatCap and baked-material renders.
The red shell remains one primary object; white wrap bands, moving latches, and the handle are separated only at genuine assembly/material boundaries.
Independent high and low collections retain live Bevel, Weighted Normal, and Solidify modifiers.
The low export survives a fresh-process GLB import with six meshes, UVs on every mesh, materials, and baked images.
limitations: The reproduction is boxier than the tutorial thumbnail and omits the deeper recessed side-panel language, cross emblem, labels, and tertiary wear.
The two front latches are simplified and their exact mechanical construction is not claimed.
The high body's extra planar grid density is a controlled workflow distinction, not an optimized final high-poly topology pattern.
The metallic map is a deliberate constant non-metal texture because the main shell is painted plastic; it is delivered but not evidence of a metallic surface bake.
